ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-contrast regions: a large, mottled white region in the upper-left lateral quadrant and a similar mottled white region in the upper-right lateral quadrant, both bordered by solid black interior and inferior zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 35-40 degree angle and a depth of roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the trailing edge; left lobe displays smaller, regular peaks; right lobe displays irregular, deeper indentations including a prominent notch near the terminal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep along the superior margins, tapering to acute lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of distinct, high-contrast circular white pixel groupings located on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, unaligned white linear markings visible across the central low-intensity regions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant u-shaped notch on the superior margin of the right fluke lobe and multiple dark focal spots within the lateral white patches.
